meaning_en: There is no deity except Allah
deep_meaning: The root A-L-H means to worship, to be divine. The phrase is a negation followed by an affirmation. It removes every claim to divinity, then places it where it belongs. It is not just a statement. It is a clearing of the heart.
why_this_phrase: It is the foundation of the message. Every prophet called to it. The Quran places it at the center of faith, and describes it as the word that stands firm.

verses.arabic: فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنبِكَ
verses.translation_en: So know that there is no deity except Allah, and ask forgiveness for your sin.
verses.context: The command to know, not only to say.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
verses.translation_en: Indeed, they, when it was said to them, 'There is no deity except Allah,' were arrogant.
verses.context: The phrase that the arrogant rejected.

verses.arabic: شَهِدَ اللَّهُ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ وَأُولُو الْعِلْمِ
verses.translation_en: Allah witnesses that there is no deity except Him, and so do the angels and those of knowledge.
verses.context: Allah bears witness to it first.

verses.arabic: يُنَزِّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةَ بِالرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ أَنْ أَنذِرُوا أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنَا فَاتَّقُونِ
verses.translation_en: He sends down the angels with the Spirit of His command upon whom He wills of His servants, 'Warn that there is no deity except Me, so fear Me.'
verses.context: The first message of every prophet.

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنَا فَاعْبُدُونِ
verses.translation_en: And We sent not before you any messenger except that We revealed to him that there is no deity except Me, so worship Me.
verses.context: The message shared by all messengers.
